simple.meaning: שְׁנִינָה (shᵉnîynâh) is a Hebrew object word meaning “something pointed , i.e. a gibe.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 28:37. The surrounding context includes kingship, land, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁנִינָה (H8148) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: שְׁנִינָה (shᵉnîynâh) / H8148 is traced through Deuteronomy 28:37, 1 Kings 9:7, 2 Chronicles 7:20, Jeremiah 24:9 with generated occurrence evidence.
